description: Helper functions for testing and controlling parallel checkout operations in a Git repository environment.

methods.name: set_checkout_config
methods.description: Sets up checkout configuration with specified number of workers and threshold.

methods.name: test_checkout_workers
methods.description: Runs a command and verifies that the expected number of checkout worker processes are started.

methods.name: verify_checkout
methods.description: Checks that the working tree and index are correctly created by comparing the current state with HEAD.
